# Hymebel — Premium Furniture for Kazakhstan & Central Asia

> Hymebel is the Central Asia brand of Hongye Furniture Group (founded 1996, Guangdong, China). We design, manufacture, ship and install furniture for hotel, office, villa, healthcare and education projects in Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan.

## Company facts (single source of truth)

- Parent group: Hongye Furniture Group, founded 1996, Guangdong, China
- Factory: 300,000 m² own production base, 1,000+ workers
- Track record: 1,000+ projects in 50+ countries
- Certifications: 8 international certifications; EAC TR CU 025/2011 compliant (mandatory furniture certification in the Central Asian customs union)
- Lead time: 30-45 days production; 9-10 days by rail to Tashkent, 5-7 days by TIR truck
- Languages served: Kazakh (default), Uzbek, English
- Contact: z@hysdfurniture.com · WhatsApp +8618038813653

## Site structure

- Default language: Kazakh at https://hymebel.com/kk/ ; Uzbek at https://hymebel.com/uz/ ; English at https://hymebel.com/en/
- Product catalogue: 75 models across 5 categories
- Blog / knowledge base: 12 in-depth guides in three languages

## Product categories

- [Hotel Furniture](https://hymebel.com/en/hotel-furniture/) — Full FF&E supply. Furniture for guest rooms, lobbies, restaurants and conference halls. Built to your drawings in 30-45 days, then 9-10 days by rail to Central Asia.
- [Office Furniture](https://hymebel.com/en/office-furniture/) — Ergonomics & workspace planning. Workstations, meeting rooms and reception areas. Our 300,000 m² factory covers large-scale rollouts.
- [Villa & Residential](https://hymebel.com/en/villa-residential/) — One manufacturer, whole home. Kitchen, living, bedroom furniture and wall panelling. A complete cycle from site survey to installation.
- [Healthcare Furniture](https://hymebel.com/en/healthcare-furniture/) — Hygiene-first materials. Furniture for patient rooms, clinics and laboratories. Easy-clean materials from certified production lines.
- [Education Furniture](https://hymebel.com/en/education-furniture/) — Bulk supply terms. Durable furniture for classrooms, libraries and laboratories, with proven bulk-supply experience for schools and universities.
